[Eastside Public Security Bureau - Class A Arrest Warrant]
Case No.: E.P.S.B.-W83401
Threat Level: Critical

[Target Info]
Codename: "Marauders"
Identity: Suspected Sinner
Unit Size: 3-4 individuals

[Case Report]
Recently, a series of malicious break-ins targeting private collections and public art galleries has occurred in the city. The suspects constitute an organized group that plans thefts and robberies targeting rare artworks and antique paintings.
Unlike ordinary thieves, this group is suspected to include Sinners among its members. During their operations, they have repeatedly inflicted serious injuries on security personnel and innocent civilians, rendering the nature of their crimes exceptionally severe.

[Suspect Profile]
Physical Description: All members wear masks or simple face coverings during operations. According to eyewitnesses, some members are dressed in tactical gear or dark clothing.
Linguistic Profile: Speaks Disian with noticeable difficulty.

[Bounty Notice]
A public bounty is hereby offered for the aforementioned criminal group. Any individual who provides actionable intelligence leading to the location of the suspects will be rewarded with 50,000 DisCoins and awarded the "Eastside Honorary Citizen" medal.
